romanceStyle.profile.flirt.name: 🦊 The Playful Charmer
romanceStyle.profile.flirt.catchphrase: I read the rhythm and let things unfold.
romanceStyle.profile.flirt.description: I notice tone and mood, then trade light signals without rushing the relationship. Patience and social intuition are part of my charm. Rather than creating distance to test someone, I can say what I am curious about honestly.
romanceStyle.profile.observer.name: 🔍 The Thoughtful Observer
romanceStyle.profile.observer.catchphras: I take time to notice the little signs.
romanceStyle.profile.observer.descriptio: I pay attention to words and expressions before deciding how I feel. Careful reflection helps me avoid jumping to conclusions. If I find myself guessing for too long, a gentle question can clear things up.
romanceStyle.profile.devoted.name: 💕 The All-In Romantic
romanceStyle.profile.devoted.catchphrase: I want to share the good moments first.
romanceStyle.profile.devoted.description: I share both joyful and difficult moments and express affection wholeheartedly. Warm encouragement and attention help a bond grow deep. Caring for myself as well as my partner keeps that love comfortable for both of us.
romanceStyle.profile.steady.name: 🌿 The Steady Presence
romanceStyle.profile.steady.catchphrase: Trust built over time makes love feel safe.
romanceStyle.profile.steady.description: I build trust through consistent messages and keeping my promises. A calm, dependable presence is one of my strengths. Every now and then, a new way to show affection or a different date can keep things fresh.
romanceStyle.profile.independent.name: 🐈 The Independent Spirit
romanceStyle.profile.independent.catchph: I stay close without losing my own rhythm.
romanceStyle.profile.independent.descrip: I make room for both a relationship and my own life, respecting each person's time. Leaving space for separate interests keeps the bond healthy. Sharing why I need time alone, along with affection, builds trust instead of distance.
romanceStyle.profile.verbal.name: 💬 The Words-of-Affection Type
romanceStyle.profile.verbal.catchphrase: I grow closer by putting feelings into words.
romanceStyle.profile.verbal.description: I say thank you, express affection, and get to know someone through conversation. Honest words help a partner feel appreciated. It is also good to notice when someone feels more comfortable with quiet actions than words.
romanceStyle.profile.caregiver.name: 🧸 The Thoughtful Caregiver
romanceStyle.profile.caregiver.catchphra: I notice what someone needs before they ask.
romanceStyle.profile.caregiver.descripti: I pay attention to my partner's energy and naturally take care of practical needs. My thoughtfulness makes me a dependable partner. Asking what kind of help they want and making time to rest keeps that care healthy.
romanceStyle.profile.playful.name: 😸 The Playful Banter Type
romanceStyle.profile.playful.catchphrase: I know how to bring laughter into a relationship.
romanceStyle.profile.playful.description: Quick wit and affectionate teasing make time together feel fun. I am good at easing awkward moments and making memories. For important conversations, I can set the jokes aside and say how I really feel.
romanceStyle.profile.thrill.name: 🎢 The Spark Seeker
romanceStyle.profile.thrill.catchphrase: I add a new scene to the days we share.
romanceStyle.profile.thrill.description: New places and spontaneous plans bring energy to my relationships. Curiosity helps us make memorable experiences together. Quiet, familiar days matter too, and appreciating them can make the excitement last longer.
romanceStyle.profile.mediator.name: 🕊️ The Conversation Builder
romanceStyle.profile.mediator.catchphras: Understanding each other matters more than winning.
romanceStyle.profile.mediator.descriptio: Even when we disagree, I try to keep talking until we find an answer that works for both of us. Listening and sorting through feelings helps us reconnect. I should remember that I do not have to mediate every time; my partner's effort matters too.
romanceStyle.profile.realistic.name: 🧭 The Practical Partner
romanceStyle.profile.realistic.catchphra: I turn affection into plans we can share.
romanceStyle.profile.realistic.descripti: I build a dependable relationship by talking through everyday routines and promises. Practical plans and consistency help us picture a future together. Making room for emotional hopes and small pleasures can make that future warmer.

fantasyClass.title: Which Fantasy Game Class Suits Me?
fantasyClass.description: Follow your choices on an adventure to discover the fantasy class that fits you.
fantasyClass.pageIntro: Picture a village you have never visited, a map still unopened, and companions ready to set out with you. Choose how you would act on the adventure to find a class that fits.
fantasyClass.aboutTitle: What role would you take on an adventure?
fantasyClass.aboutDescription: Follow choices about guild quests, ruins, and helping companions to see which role you picture yourself taking first. Your class reflects choices about exploration, preparation, and support as well as combat.
fantasyClass.reference: Use the result as an idea for a character or a party role with friends. It is a fantasy game, not a measure of gaming skill or personality, and different choices could lead to a different class.
seo.title.fantasy-class-test: Which Fantasy Game Class Suits Me? — molgga
seo.description.fantasy-class-test: Choose how you would take on quests and help companions to find a fantasy class that suits you.
fantasyClass.question.1: You find your first quest at the adventurers' guild. Which do you choose?
fantasyClass.question.1.b: Decode the writing in an old ruin
fantasyClass.question.1.c: Treat an injured traveler and guide them to safety
fantasyClass.question.1.d: Explore a forest path missing from the map
fantasyClass.question.2: You can pack one more thing besides your gear. What do you bring?
fantasyClass.question.2.a: A sturdy rope with many uses
fantasyClass.question.2.b: A book about the region's history and magic
fantasyClass.question.2.c: Herbs and bandages to share with the group
fantasyClass.question.3: A stone door blocks the entrance to an old ruin. What do you do?
fantasyClass.question.3.b: Study the symbols and mechanism on the door
fantasyClass.question.3.c: Walk around and look for another entrance
fantasyClass.question.3.d: Find someone in a nearby village who knows the ruin
fantasyClass.question.4: You have to spend the night in the forest. What would you like to do?
fantasyClass.question.4.b: Use maps and notes to plan tomorrow's route
fantasyClass.question.4.c: Check on everyone and prepare a place to rest
fantasyClass.question.4.d: Share a short story or play music by the fire
fantasyClass.question.5: A monster appears. What role would you most like to take?
fantasyClass.question.5.a: Charge in and start the fight
fantasyClass.question.5.b: Stand between the monster and your companions
fantasyClass.question.5.c: Keep your distance and aim for a weak spot
fantasyClass.question.5.d: Use magic to slow the monster down
fantasyClass.question.6: You find something you need at the market, but the price is a little high. What do you do?
fantasyClass.question.6.a: Buy it if it is essential, then move on
fantasyClass.question.6.b: Compare prices and quality at other shops
fantasyClass.question.6.c: Ask about trading something or negotiating the price
fantasyClass.question.6.d: Look for another item that can do the same job
fantasyClass.question.7: You finish a quest and get a day to rest. What would you do?
fantasyClass.question.7.a: Practice with weapons and armor at the training ground
fantasyClass.question.7.b: Look up a spell in the magic library
fantasyClass.question.7.c: Walk beyond the village and scout places to visit next
fantasyClass.question.7.d: Listen to people's stories or play an instrument at the inn
fantasyClass.question.8: A companion is hurt, and the destination is still a little farther away. What do you do?
fantasyClass.question.8.a: Share the load so your companion can rest
fantasyClass.question.8.b: Check the wound and treat it first
fantasyClass.question.8.c: Look for a shorter, safer path nearby
fantasyClass.question.8.d: Find transport or help in a nearby village
fantasyClass.profile.warrior.name: Warrior
fantasyClass.profile.warrior.catchphrase: When a fight begins, you step forward and clear the way.
fantasyClass.profile.warrior.description: You prefer to respond directly with a blade instead of spending too long preparing. Knowing when to press forward and when to fall back can also give your companions room to move.
fantasyClass.profile.warrior.shareDescri: You are a warrior type who meets nearby enemies and makes a path when the group needs one.
fantasyClass.profile.warrior.gear: Sword, axe, and heavy armor help you hold your ground in close combat.
fantasyClass.profile.warrior.skill: Cleave — strike a nearby enemy with your weapon.
fantasyClass.profile.warrior.role: Take on close-range combat and clear obstacles from the path.
fantasyClass.profile.warrior.teammate: Priest — helps you recover after a fight so the journey can continue.
fantasyClass.profile.knight.name: Knight
fantasyClass.profile.knight.catchphrase: You hold the line and make room for your companions.
fantasyClass.profile.knight.description: You are drawn to holding your position and taking the brunt of danger rather than rushing to attack. Watching both the fight and your companions helps you raise your shield at the right moment.
fantasyClass.profile.knight.shareDescrip: You are a knight type who protects companions with a shield and holds steady in battle.
fantasyClass.profile.knight.gear: A one-handed sword, shield, and heavy armor help absorb enemy attacks.
fantasyClass.profile.knight.skill: Shield Block — block an attack coming from the front.
fantasyClass.profile.knight.role: Defend the group and create space for companions to move safely.
fantasyClass.profile.knight.teammate: Mage — can prepare a spell while you guard the front.
fantasyClass.profile.mage.name: Mage
fantasyClass.profile.mage.catchphrase: You change the course of an adventure with knowledge and spells.
fantasyClass.profile.mage.description: You like studying writing and mechanisms, then using magic to attack or change the surroundings. Your style suits choosing the right tools while keeping track of time and mana.
fantasyClass.profile.mage.shareDescripti: You are a mage type who uses spells and knowledge to help in combat and ruin exploration.
fantasyClass.profile.mage.gear: A staff, spellbook, and robe help you prepare your magic.
fantasyClass.profile.mage.skill: Frost Spell — slow enemies in a small area.
fantasyClass.profile.mage.role: Provide magical attacks and help interpret ruins.
fantasyClass.profile.mage.teammate: Knight — can hold off attacks while you prepare a spell.
fantasyClass.profile.priest.name: Priest
fantasyClass.profile.priest.catchphrase: You help the group continue with healing and protection.
fantasyClass.profile.priest.description: You find purpose in keeping the group safe through healing and protection rather than leading every attack. Watching for the right moment to heal and saving some mana can help on a long journey.
fantasyClass.profile.priest.shareDescrip: You are a priest type who supports the group with healing and protective magic.
fantasyClass.profile.priest.gear: A holy symbol, staff, and robe help you prepare healing magic.
fantasyClass.profile.priest.skill: Heal — restore the wounds of one companion.
fantasyClass.profile.priest.role: Handle healing, protection, and clearing harmful effects.
fantasyClass.profile.priest.teammate: Warrior — you can help a companion who fights up close recover.
fantasyClass.profile.ranger.name: Ranger
fantasyClass.profile.ranger.catchphrase: You find paths and targets, even in unfamiliar places.
fantasyClass.profile.ranger.description: You are drawn to reading signs in the woods and fighting with a bow from a distance. Using the terrain and securing a route first can help the group travel more safely.
fantasyClass.profile.ranger.shareDescrip: You are a ranger type who observes the area, finds paths, and supports the group with ranged attacks.
fantasyClass.profile.ranger.gear: A bow, dagger, and light leather armor help you move through the wilds.
fantasyClass.profile.ranger.skill: Track — find a route from footprints and other traces.
fantasyClass.profile.ranger.role: Scout, find routes, and attack from a distance.
fantasyClass.profile.ranger.teammate: Rogue — together you can explore the area and find a safe way in.
fantasyClass.profile.rogue.name: Rogue
fantasyClass.profile.rogue.catchphrase: When the direct route is blocked, you look for another way.
fantasyClass.profile.rogue.description: You like checking locks and traps and moving along routes that draw less attention. Your style includes planning how to get back out as well as how to get in.
fantasyClass.profile.rogue.shareDescript: You are a rogue type who checks locked doors and traps and finds a quieter route.
fantasyClass.profile.rogue.gear: A dagger, lockpicks, and light armor help you stay ready and move quietly.
fantasyClass.profile.rogue.skill: Unlock — open a locked door or chest.
fantasyClass.profile.rogue.role: Handle stealth, disarm traps, and search for treasure.
fantasyClass.profile.rogue.teammate: Ranger — can watch nearby movement and help secure a route.
fantasyClass.profile.merchant.name: Merchant
fantasyClass.profile.merchant.catchphras: You gather what the group needs with the resources at hand.
fantasyClass.profile.merchant.descriptio: You compare an item's price and usefulness, then prepare for the group's next stop through trade. Your style suits keeping an adventure moving with choices beyond combat.
fantasyClass.profile.merchant.shareDescr: You are a merchant type who gets supplies for the group through trade and planning.
fantasyClass.profile.merchant.gear: A travel bag, ledger, and small dagger for protection keep you prepared.
fantasyClass.profile.merchant.skill: Barter — trade what you have for supplies you need.
fantasyClass.profile.merchant.role: Handle supplies, trade, and travel preparations.
fantasyClass.profile.merchant.teammate: Ranger — can share information about new paths and villages.
fantasyClass.profile.bard.name: Bard
fantasyClass.profile.bard.catchphrase: You lift the group's spirits with music and stories.
fantasyClass.profile.bard.description: You like talking with people and using music to bring warmth to different moments. You enjoy noticing what the group needs in battle or in town, then choosing the right words or story.
fantasyClass.profile.bard.shareDescripti: You are a bard type who encourages companions with music and gathers stories around town.
fantasyClass.profile.bard.gear: An instrument, travel journal, and light weapon help you along the way.
fantasyClass.profile.bard.skill: Marching Song — help companions keep a steady pace.
fantasyClass.profile.bard.role: Support companions, gather rumors, and record the adventure.
fantasyClass.profile.bard.teammate: Merchant — together you can find supplies and news as you travel between towns.

shopStory.intro.1: You arrive in a small village between a forest and a castle.
shopStory.intro.2:
The square has a bakery and a general store, and travelers’ wagons stop at the village entrance. A notice on the board catches your eye.
“Shop space for rent. There’s a little loft above it.”
shopStory.intro.3: You have a few silver coins saved away. You take a look around the shop and decide to open a business here.
shopStory.scene.1.title: Choose a shop location
shopStory.scene.1.situation: The caretaker hands you four keys. The rent is about the same for each place, but each has a different view.
shopStory.scene.1.prompt: Where would you open your shop?
shopStory.scene.1.imageAlt: A village view showing the entrance, square, bookshop lane, and nearby forest
shopStory.scene.1.choice.a: The village entrance, where travelers pass by.
shopStory.scene.1.reaction.a: A wagon stops by the road. Travelers can easily drop in here.
shopStory.scene.1.choice.b: The busy square, where residents come to shop.
shopStory.scene.1.reaction.b: People crossing the square pass by the empty shop.
shopStory.scene.1.choice.c: A quiet lane beside an old bookshop.
shopStory.scene.1.reaction.c: As you walk into the lane, the noise outside grows softer.
shopStory.scene.1.choice.d: Near the forest, with room for a small garden.
shopStory.scene.1.reaction.d: There’s a sunny patch of earth beside the building.
shopStory.scene.2.title: Things left behind
shopStory.scene.2.situation: When you open the door, you find things left by the previous owner. After dusting them off, they still seem useful.
shopStory.scene.2.prompt: What would you fix up first?
shopStory.scene.2.imageAlt: An empty shop with a table, shelves, workbench, and potted plant
shopStory.scene.2.choice.a: A long table and chairs. Make a place for people to sit.
shopStory.scene.2.reaction.a: You wipe down a chair and set it beside the table. There’s now a place to rest.
shopStory.scene.2.choice.b: Wall shelves. Sort and display things on them.
shopStory.scene.2.reaction.b: As you clean the shelves, you imagine what might go on them.
shopStory.scene.2.choice.c: A sturdy workbench. Set out tools and check its condition.
shopStory.scene.2.reaction.c: The workbench is steady. A little care should make it ready to use.
shopStory.scene.2.choice.d: The potted plant by the window. Refresh its soil and water it.
shopStory.scene.2.reaction.d: You loosen the soil and water the plant. The window looks tidier now.
shopStory.scene.3.title: Shopping at the market
shopStory.scene.3.situation: You head to the market for opening-day supplies. Your budget is modest, so you can’t buy everything at once.
shopStory.scene.3.imageAlt: Market stalls displaying ingredients, travel goods, tools, seeds, and glass jars
shopStory.scene.3.choice.a: Flour and tea leaves, ready to serve visitors.
shopStory.scene.3.reaction.a: The seller divides the ingredients into small paper packets.
shopStory.scene.3.choice.b: Travel pouches and handy everyday goods.
shopStory.scene.3.reaction.b: You put a rope, candles, and a pouch into the box.
shopStory.scene.3.choice.c: Metal pieces and repair tools, ready for commissions.
shopStory.scene.3.reaction.c: You inspect each tool and choose the ones that fit your hand.
shopStory.scene.3.choice.d: Herb seeds and glass jars, ready to grow or make things yourself.
shopStory.scene.3.reaction.d: You wrap the seed packets and jars in cloth so they won’t knock together.
shopStory.scene.4.title: Adding a little everyday magic
shopStory.scene.4.situation: A local mage offers a small gift for your opening. Grand spells are out of reach, but this one could make daily life a little easier.
shopStory.scene.4.imageAlt: A mage showing a small warming stand, glowing drawer handle, work light, and bell
shopStory.scene.4.choice.a: A charm that keeps food and tea warm longer.
shopStory.scene.4.reaction.a: The mage hands you a small warming stand. Steam curls from a teacup set on it.
shopStory.scene.4.choice.b: A charm that helps find things in drawers.
shopStory.scene.4.reaction.b: You name an item, and the right drawer handle glimmers faintly.
shopStory.scene.4.choice.c: A light that evenly illuminates the workbench.
shopStory.scene.4.reaction.c: A light comes on above the workbench. Your hands cast no heavy shadow.
shopStory.scene.4.choice.d: A bell that rings when a potted plant needs water.
shopStory.scene.4.reaction.d: The mage hangs a little bell beside the plant and gives it a quick test.
shopStory.scene.5.title: The first visitor
shopStory.scene.5.situation:
The shop isn’t open yet when someone knocks. A traveler with a worn backpack stands at the door.
“Would it be all right if I came in for a moment? It’s raining.”
shopStory.scene.5.imageAlt: A traveler in a dark green cloak with a worn brown backpack at an open shop on a rainy day
shopStory.scene.5.choice.a: Offer a chair and make a warm cup of tea.
shopStory.scene.5.reaction.a: The traveler takes the cup and warms their hands for a moment.
shopStory.scene.5.choice.b: Make a place for their wet things and offer a dry cloth.
shopStory.scene.5.reaction.b: The traveler sets down the backpack and wipes away the rain.
shopStory.scene.5.choice.c: Notice the broken backpack strap and ask if they’d like it mended.
shopStory.scene.5.reaction.c: The traveler nods and hands over the backpack.
shopStory.scene.5.choice.d: Clear a spot by the stove and give them time to rest.
shopStory.scene.5.reaction.d: The traveler sits by the stove and waits quietly for the rain to pass.
shopStory.scene.6.title: A sign for the shop
shopStory.scene.6.situation:
A neighbor drops by before opening day.
“At first, you never know who might come in. A small sign can help.”
shopStory.scene.6.prompt: What would you write on it?
shopStory.scene.6.imageAlt: A blank sheet of paper and pen on the counter, with a neighboring shopkeeper
shopStory.scene.6.choice.a: “Warm meals and a place to rest.”
shopStory.scene.6.reaction.a: A traveler passing by reads the sign and peeks inside.
shopStory.scene.6.reaction.b: Your neighbor says they’ll stop by on market day for a few things.
shopStory.scene.6.choice.c: “Bring in broken things for a repair.”
shopStory.scene.6.reaction.c: Your neighbor asks if they can bring an old tool from home.
shopStory.scene.6.reaction.d: Your neighbor wonders what you’re getting ready to make.
shopStory.scene.7.title: Closing up on opening day
shopStory.scene.7.situation: At last, it’s the shop’s first day. A few people came in to look around, though it wasn’t crowded.
shopStory.scene.7.prompt: How would you spend the time before closing?
shopStory.scene.7.imageAlt: A shop at dusk with its door closed and a small ledger on the counter
shopStory.scene.7.choice.a: Prepare a new dish for tomorrow’s visitors.
shopStory.scene.7.reaction.a: You bring out the ingredients and start with a small batch.
shopStory.scene.7.choice.b: Write down the items people asked for today.
shopStory.scene.7.reaction.b: Your list for the next market day grows by a few lines.
shopStory.scene.7.choice.c: Rearrange a tool or move the workbench to a better spot.
shopStory.scene.7.reaction.c: You move the tools you use most closer at hand.
shopStory.scene.7.choice.d: Tidy the window and check on the plants and displays.
shopStory.scene.7.reaction.d: You wipe the window and straighten a few things before calling it a day.
shopStory.scene.8.title: A returning visitor
shopStory.scene.8.situation: A few days later, the traveler who first stopped by returns.
shopStory.scene.8.prompt: What would be good to hear from them?
shopStory.scene.8.imageAlt: A traveler in the same dark green cloak and brown backpack entering the shop on a clear day
shopStory.scene.8.choice.a: “Your shop looks welcoming. May I look around for a moment?”
shopStory.scene.8.reaction.a: The traveler looks around for a place to pause for a little while.
shopStory.scene.8.choice.b: “I’m looking for a few things for this trip.”
shopStory.scene.8.reaction.b: The traveler lists a few things they’ll need for the journey.
shopStory.scene.8.choice.c: “My backpack strap has come loose. Could you take a look?”
shopStory.scene.8.reaction.c: The traveler hands you the backpack. You can check the strap first.
shopStory.scene.8.choice.d: “May I take a look at what you have here?”
shopStory.scene.8.reaction.d: The traveler looks over the things displayed on the shelves.
shopStory.profile.inn.name: Small inn
shopStory.profile.inn.catchphrase: A place where travelers set down their packs
shopStory.profile.inn.description: A few tables fill the ground floor, with small guest rooms upstairs. Preparing a warm meal and a clean bed is the main work of the day. In the evening, guests trade stories from the roads they have taken.
shopStory.profile.inn.shareDescription: An inn where you prepare meals and a place to sleep, while travelers share stories from the road.
shopStory.profile.inn.regular: A courier who travels between villages
shopStory.profile.inn.scenery: A place by the door lets guests hang up wet coats.
shopStory.profile.generalStore.name: General store
shopStory.profile.generalStore.catchphra: A little of what people need
shopStory.profile.generalStore.descripti: You sell all sorts of useful things, from rope and candles to travel flasks. You keep notes on what people ask for and bring it in on the next market day. It may look busy at first, but you know what belongs in every drawer.
shopStory.profile.generalStore.shareDesc: A village shop stocked with useful travel goods, with requests from neighbors written down for the next market day.
shopStory.profile.generalStore.offering: Everyday goods, travel tools, and small pouches
shopStory.profile.generalStore.regular: A new adventurer stocking up before a trip
shopStory.profile.generalStore.scenery: A few unclaimed items sit beside the counter.
shopStory.profile.repairWorkshop.name: Repair workshop
shopStory.profile.repairWorkshop.catchph: A place that gives familiar things another life
shopStory.profile.repairWorkshop.descrip: You take in things that need mending, from door handles and travel bags to armor buckles. You inspect the damage and explain how much time and work it will take. Items waiting for their owners sit neatly along one side of the workbench.
shopStory.profile.repairWorkshop.shareDe: A workshop where you inspect broken household items and travel gear, explain the repairs, and help put them back to use.
shopStory.profile.repairWorkshop.offerin: Household repairs, gear care, and simple crafting
shopStory.profile.repairWorkshop.regular: A guard who keeps wearing the same old boots
shopStory.profile.repairWorkshop.scenery: In the afternoon, the sounds of tools drift through the open window.
shopStory.profile.herbShop.name: Herb shop
shopStory.profile.herbShop.catchphrase: Shelves that change a little with the seasons
shopStory.profile.herbShop.description: You grow herbs in the garden and sell dried leaves and scented sachets. You explain how to use and store each one. There may be fewer things to sell after a small harvest, but there are always plants to tend.
shopStory.profile.herbShop.shareDescript: A small shop where you tend the garden and prepare dried herbs and scented sachets as the seasons change.
shopStory.profile.herbShop.offering: Dried herbs, scented sachets, and herbal tea
shopStory.profile.herbShop.regular: A neighbor choosing leaves for tea
shopStory.profile.herbShop.scenery: A small tray of leaves sits by the window to dry.
shopStory.profile.magicToolShop.name: Magic tool shop
shopStory.profile.magicToolShop.descript: You sell stones that glow softly at night and lenses that briefly magnify writing. Sample tools are ready for visitors to try before choosing one. Every so often, you inspect a tool that has stopped working.
shopStory.profile.magicToolShop.shareDes: A little shop where visitors can try small, useful magic tools before choosing one.
shopStory.profile.magicToolShop.offering: Glowstones, magic lenses, and slow-drying ink pens
shopStory.profile.magicToolShop.regular: A magic-school student shopping for class
shopStory.profile.magicToolShop.scenery: Small instruction cards are tucked beside the tools on each shelf.
shopStory.profile.teaShop.name: Tea shop
shopStory.profile.teaShop.catchphrase: A place to sit and catch your breath
shopStory.profile.teaShop.description: This little shop serves tea and a few baked treats. There are seats where visitors on their own can feel at ease. The atmosphere shifts between busy hours and quieter moments.
shopStory.profile.teaShop.shareDescripti: A tea shop with small treats and a comfortable seat for anyone stopping by on their own.
shopStory.profile.teaShop.offering: Hot tea, seasonal fruit tea, and small biscuits
shopStory.profile.teaShop.regular: A neighboring shopkeeper stopping in after work
shopStory.profile.teaShop.scenery: A book someone left beside the window seat is still waiting to be picked up.
seo.title.night-train-test: I Boarded the Train That Only Comes at Night — Which Station Will I Reach? | molgga
seo.description.night-train-test: Board a train that runs only at night and follow your choices to discover the station where you get off.
nightTrain.title: I boarded the train that only comes at night. Which station will I get off at?
nightTrain.description: Board a train that comes only at night and follow your choices to find your station.
nightTrain.pageIntro: You step aboard an old train that runs only at night. Follow the passing scenery and the people you meet to choose where to get off.
nightTrain.sharePrompt: I rode the night train and found my station.
nightTrain.startTitle: The night line appears on a dark platform
nightTrain.intro.1: I thought I had missed the last train.
nightTrain.intro.2: I turned away from the unlit platform when a small light appeared at the end of the tracks. An old train slowed to a quiet stop.
nightTrain.intro.3: A conductor stood beside the open door. “Would you like to get on? This train only runs at night.” The destination board said “Night Line” instead of a station name. Once aboard, the conductor handed me a blank ticket. “You can decide where to get off along the way.”
nightTrain.startImageAlt: An old night train stopped at a dark platform with its carriage door open
nightTrain.resultImageAlt: A station where the night train has stopped
nightTrain.aboutTitle: A short story aboard the night train
nightTrain.aboutDescription: Follow the people you meet and the scenery outside the window, then choose the station where you get off.
nightTrain.reference: A short story for fun, not a personality assessment or a test with a right answer. Your choices shape the station where you arrive.
nightTrain.scene.1.title: An empty seat
nightTrain.scene.1.situation: A few passengers are scattered through the carriage. Four seats look inviting.
nightTrain.scene.1.imageAlt: An empty seat, an old route map, and a passenger with a travel case inside the train
nightTrain.scene.1.choice.a: By the window, with a view of the passing scenery.
nightTrain.scene.1.reaction.a: The carriage lights reflect in the glass as the dark scenery drifts past.
nightTrain.scene.1.choice.b: Beside the old route map on the wall.
nightTrain.scene.1.reaction.b: The map still shows station names that are no longer in use.
nightTrain.scene.1.choice.c: Across from a passenger with a small travel case.
nightTrain.scene.1.reaction.c: The passenger moves their case to make a little room.
nightTrain.scene.1.choice.d: Where soft music and a potted plant are visible in the next carriage.
nightTrain.scene.1.reaction.d: A small plant and a slow melody catch your eye between the carriages.
nightTrain.scene.2.title: Lights beyond the window
nightTrain.scene.2.situation: The train emerges from a tunnel. Different lights glimmer in the distance.
nightTrain.scene.2.prompt: Which view would you like to see more of?
nightTrain.scene.2.imageAlt: Water, forest, town, and snow-covered rooftops seen from the night train
nightTrain.scene.2.choice.a: A lighthouse reflected in a long line across the water.
nightTrain.scene.2.reaction.a: The light stretches and wavers across the water whenever the train leans.
nightTrain.scene.2.choice.b: Small lanterns scattered between the trees.
nightTrain.scene.2.reaction.b: A few forest lanterns appear, then slip out of sight.
nightTrain.scene.2.choice.c: A street where shops are still open at night.
nightTrain.scene.2.reaction.c: Shadows pass by open shops and people moving along the street.
nightTrain.scene.2.reaction.d: Smoke drifts low above the snow-covered roofs.
nightTrain.scene.3.title: The passenger across the aisle
nightTrain.scene.3.situation: The passenger across from you unfolds a few picture postcards. “You can have one. I have several of each.”
nightTrain.scene.3.imageAlt: A passenger showing several picture postcards without writing
nightTrain.scene.3.choice.a: A harbor with small boats at anchor.
nightTrain.scene.3.reaction.a: Several small boats are tied along the pier in the picture.
nightTrain.scene.3.choice.b: A bench beneath a very large tree.
nightTrain.scene.3.reaction.b: A quiet empty bench rests beneath the tree’s shade.
nightTrain.scene.3.choice.c: A market lane lined with awnings and signs.
nightTrain.scene.3.reaction.c: A narrow lane runs between colorful awnings.
nightTrain.scene.3.choice.d: Flowers beneath the glass roof of a greenhouse.
nightTrain.scene.3.reaction.d: Little flowers lift their heads beneath the glass, even at night.
nightTrain.scene.4.title: The dining car
nightTrain.scene.4.situation: Simple food and drinks are available in the dining car. You sit by a window, and a server comes to take your order.
nightTrain.scene.4.imageAlt: Soup, bread, a teapot, a snack bag, and sparkling water in the train dining car
nightTrain.scene.4.reaction.a: Steam rises from the soup, with a slice of fresh bread beside it.
nightTrain.scene.4.reaction.b: A gentle aroma rises as tea is poured into the cup.
nightTrain.scene.4.choice.c: A snack in a paper bag to eat on the way back to your seat.
nightTrain.scene.4.reaction.c: You take the paper bag and head back to the carriage.
nightTrain.scene.4.choice.d: Cold sparkling water, then a little more time by the window.
nightTrain.scene.4.reaction.d: Night scenery drifts past the water droplets on the glass.
nightTrain.scene.5.title: A brief stop
nightTrain.scene.5.situation: The train stops at a small platform with no name. The conductor says, “We’ll pause here for a moment. You may step out, but come back when the bell rings twice.”
nightTrain.scene.5.prompt: What would you do during the stop?
nightTrain.scene.5.imageAlt: A small night platform, waiting room, map, snack stall, and potted plants
nightTrain.scene.5.choice.a: Walk to the end of the platform for some fresh air.
nightTrain.scene.5.reaction.a: At the end of the platform, the cool night air brushes your face.
nightTrain.scene.5.choice.b: Read the local map and old timetable on the wall.
nightTrain.scene.5.reaction.b: A faded route that no longer runs is visible in one corner of the map.
nightTrain.scene.5.choice.c: Browse the snacks at a small stall.
nightTrain.scene.5.reaction.c: The stall owner offers a taste of something baked today.
nightTrain.scene.5.choice.d: Sit for a moment in the waiting room with the plants.
nightTrain.scene.5.reaction.d: The waiting room is quiet, with a small flower in the window.
nightTrain.scene.6.title: The next station announcement
nightTrain.scene.6.situation: As the train starts moving again, the conductor walks through the carriage. “From here on, there are stations where you may get off. Ring the platform bell if you’d like to take the train back.”
nightTrain.scene.6.prompt: What would you like to do first after arriving?
nightTrain.scene.6.imageAlt: An unnamed station, a lane, a shop, and an old building seen from the night train
nightTrain.scene.6.choice.a: Take a slow walk along a quiet street.
nightTrain.scene.6.reaction.a: A road with only a few streetlamps stretches beyond the window.
nightTrain.scene.6.choice.b: Step into an open shop and talk with the owner.
nightTrain.scene.6.reaction.b: A shop is still lit, and voices carry from inside.
nightTrain.scene.6.choice.c: Look for an old building marked on the map.
nightTrain.scene.6.reaction.c: The roof of an old building appears not far from the station.
nightTrain.scene.6.choice.d: Find a seat and order something to eat or drink.
nightTrain.scene.6.reaction.d: There is an empty seat inside a warmly lit shop.
nightTrain.scene.7.title: Something from the travel case
nightTrain.scene.7.situation: The passenger across the aisle takes a few small things out of their case. “Different stations call for different things.”
nightTrain.scene.7.imageAlt: An open travel case on the train seat with a scarf, flashlight, coins, and notebook
nightTrain.scene.7.choice.a: A thick scarf to keep out the wind.
nightTrain.scene.7.reaction.a: The scarf softens the chill coming from the window.
nightTrain.scene.7.choice.b: A small flashlight for a dark path.
nightTrain.scene.7.reaction.b: The flashlight makes the path ahead easier to see.
nightTrain.scene.7.choice.c: A few coins to spend at a shop.
nightTrain.scene.7.reaction.c: The passenger places a few coins in a small pouch and hands it over.
nightTrain.scene.7.choice.d: A notebook and pencil to jot things down.
nightTrain.scene.7.reaction.d: You open a blank page as the train rocks the pencil tip across it.
nightTrain.scene.8.title: Getting ready to get off
nightTrain.scene.8.situation: The conductor stands by the carriage door. The scenery of the next station appears in the window.
nightTrain.scene.8.prompt: What kind of place would make you stand up?
nightTrain.scene.8.imageAlt: Hints of a harbor, forest, market, and clock station reflected in the night train window
nightTrain.scene.8.choice.a: A place with the sea in view and a lighthouse at the end of the pier.
nightTrain.scene.8.reaction.a: A lighthouse beam passes once through the darkness outside.
nightTrain.scene.8.choice.b: A path between trees leading to a small lodge.
nightTrain.scene.8.reaction.b: A small lodge window glows between the trees.
nightTrain.scene.8.choice.c: A platform filled with the smell of food and the sound of voices.
nightTrain.scene.8.reaction.c: Before the doors open, voices and the smell of food reach the carriage.
nightTrain.scene.8.choice.d: A station with a large clock and an old route map.
nightTrain.scene.8.reaction.d: A dim light glows beneath a large clock in the station.
nightTrain.result.harbor.name: Lighthouse Harbor
nightTrain.result.harbor.catchphrase: A small harbor beside the night sea
nightTrain.result.harbor.description: The pier begins just outside the station. A few boats are moored nearby, and a lighthouse sweeps its beam from afar. People quietly move supplies for the first departures at dawn.
nightTrain.result.harbor.shareDescriptio: A station where you can watch the lighthouse and the harbor waking before sunrise.
nightTrain.result.harbor.station: A pier with a lighthouse in the distance
nightTrain.result.harbor.people: Sailors and porters preparing for an early departure
nightTrain.result.harbor.afterArrival: At the end of the pier, you find a small diner. The owner is bringing in a chair when they notice you. “You came by train? There’s a little soup left.” From the window, you can see the lighthouse. Before the soup cools, a boat leaves the harbor.
nightTrain.result.harbor.imageAlt: A night harbor with moored boats, a distant lighthouse, and a small diner glowing warmly
nightTrain.result.forest.name: Lanternwood Station
nightTrain.result.forest.catchphrase: A forest station reached by lantern light
nightTrain.result.forest.description: A forest path begins at the small platform. Lanterns are spaced so that each one leads to the next. At the end of the path is a lodge that welcomes guests at night.
nightTrain.result.forest.shareDescriptio: Lanterns lead from the platform through the woods to a mountain lodge.
nightTrain.result.forest.station: A lantern-lit path and a lodge
nightTrain.result.forest.people: A lodge keeper welcoming late-night guests
nightTrain.result.forest.afterArrival: Leaves rustle as you follow the lanterns. A dog asleep by the hearth lifts its head when you open the lodge door. The keeper adds another log. “The path wasn’t too hard, was it? Shall I make you some tea?” Pictures of birds from the forest hang on the wall.
nightTrain.result.forest.imageAlt: A warm lodge at the end of a lantern-lit path through the forest
nightTrain.result.market.name: Night Market Station
nightTrain.result.market.catchphrase: A lane where the stalls are still open
nightTrain.result.market.description: Steps from the platform lead straight to the market. Food stalls sit beside shops selling old odds and ends. More often than customers, you see shopkeepers talking among themselves.
nightTrain.result.market.shareDescriptio: The train doors open to food aromas and the last lights of the market.
nightTrain.result.market.station: A market lane beside the platform
nightTrain.result.market.afterArrival: Steam from dumplings drifts across the lane. One stall displays keys with no obvious use. “I have plenty of keys, but I don’t know what any of them open,” the vendor laughs, offering you a small plate. You decide to try a dumpling before looking around.
nightTrain.result.market.imageAlt: A night market of dumpling stalls and shops selling curious old things
nightTrain.result.snow.name: Snowfield Station
nightTrain.result.snow.catchphrase: A small stop in a village under snow
nightTrain.result.snow.description: Snow rests on the platform roof. A short street leads to an inn and a bakery standing side by side. Your footprints remain on the fresh snow.
nightTrain.result.snow.shareDescription: An inn and bakery stand at the end of a short snowy street.
nightTrain.result.snow.station: A snow-covered platform and village street
nightTrain.result.snow.people: A baker preparing dough for the morning
nightTrain.result.snow.afterArrival: You pull your coat close and cross the street. Inside the bakery, the owner is preparing dough for tomorrow. “This is all I have for sale right now.” Two warm rolls go into a paper bag. A light is on at the inn next door, so you knock with the bag in hand.
nightTrain.result.snow.imageAlt: An inn and bakery beside a platform dusted with snow
nightTrain.result.greenhouse.name: Glasshouse Station
nightTrain.result.greenhouse.catchphrase: A station where flowers bloom at night
nightTrain.result.greenhouse.description: A long corridor connects the waiting room to the greenhouse. It is a little warmer inside, and droplets gather on the glass roof. Small observation cards sit beside plants that flower at night.
nightTrain.result.greenhouse.shareDescri: A glass-roofed greenhouse linked to the station is warm even at night.
nightTrain.result.greenhouse.station: A warm greenhouse beside the waiting room
nightTrain.result.greenhouse.people: A greenhouse keeper watching for night blooms
nightTrain.result.greenhouse.afterArriva: The keeper sets down a watering can. “You came at the right time. That flower just opened.” A small white blossom gives off a faint scent. From the bench, you watch its petals slowly unfold. The keeper notes the time and walks to the next pot.
nightTrain.result.greenhouse.imageAlt: A glasshouse where small flowers open beneath a roof dotted with night dew
nightTrain.result.clock.name: Old Clock Station
nightTrain.result.clock.catchphrase: The last stop on an old railway line
nightTrain.result.clock.description: A large clock hangs on the brick station building. An unused ticket window and an old route map remain inside. One room displays objects collected at the station.
nightTrain.result.clock.shareDescription: A quiet terminus with a large clock and an old timetable.
nightTrain.result.clock.station: A brick station with an old route map
nightTrain.result.clock.people: A keeper sorting objects from the station
nightTrain.result.clock.afterArrival: The station is quiet. Behind the old ticket window, the keeper sets down a duster. “You have a Night Line ticket. It’s been a long time since I saw one here.” Faded timetables and old tickets fill the display room. When you place the blank ticket among them, the station name slowly fades from the paper.
nightTrain.result.clock.imageAlt: A brick station with a large clock, an old route map, and faded tickets on display

seo.title.month-stay-worldcup: World Cup: Where Would You Live for a Month? | Molgga

monthStay.eyebrow: molgga PLAY · LIVE SOMEWHERE FOR A MONTH
monthStay.title: World Cup: Where Would You Live for a Month?
monthStay.intro: From an apartment in an unfamiliar city to a little house by the sea. Where would you choose to spend a month?
monthStay.participation: Choose the place you'd most like to call home for a month.
monthStay.matchTitle: Where would you most like to stay for a month?
monthStay.matchPrompt: Choose the place you'd rather stay for a month.

content.rest-style.title: How Do You Like to Rest and Recharge?
content.rest-style.description: Find the kind of rest that suits you.
seo.title.rest-style-test: How Do You Recharge? Rest Style Quiz | molgga
seo.description.rest-style-test: Answer a few questions to find the kind of rest that suits you.
restStyle.sharePrompt: How do you like to rest and recharge?
restStyle.title: How Do You Like to Rest and Recharge?
restStyle.intro: Ever rested and still not felt refreshed? Make a few choices to find a way to rest that suits you.
restStyle.aboutCopy: The choices cover quiet time alone, light movement, talking with someone you trust, getting absorbed in a hobby, and visiting somewhere new. You do not have to stick to one way of resting; answer with your recent days in mind.
restStyle.resultGuide: Try just one small suggestion on the day you see your result. After a walk or a little time away from your phone, notice how you feel; that can help with your next break. This is a casual prompt based on your recent choices, not a measure of your wellbeing.
restStyle.shareSuffix: A lighthearted look at your rest preferences. Find out how your friends recharge, too!
restStyle.question.1: A long day is over. What sounds best right now?
restStyle.answer.1.quiet: Rest somewhere quiet without checking in with anyone
restStyle.answer.1.movement: Step outside for an easy walk
restStyle.answer.1.connection: Share a meal and a chat with someone you feel comfortable with
restStyle.answer.1.immersion: Get absorbed in a favorite hobby
restStyle.answer.1.novelty: Look around somewhere you have never been
restStyle.question.2: You suddenly have a free half-day. How would you spend it?
restStyle.answer.2.quiet: Sleep in and take it easy
restStyle.answer.2.movement: Go for a walk or do something light and active
restStyle.answer.2.connection: Make plans with a friend or family member
restStyle.answer.2.immersion: Enjoy a hobby you have been putting off, like reading, gaming, or making something
restStyle.answer.2.novelty: Visit a cafe or neighborhood you have not tried
restStyle.question.3: When your mind feels busy, what helps you feel most at ease?
restStyle.answer.3.quiet: Make some quiet time for yourself

restStyle.result.quiet.name: Quiet Recharge
restStyle.result.quiet.catchphrase: You need quiet time to clear your mind.
restStyle.result.quiet.description: You tend to feel restored after stepping away from people and plans for a while. Unhurried time on your own can be meaningful rest, too.
restStyle.result.quiet.good: Try turning off notifications and taking some time for yourself. A favorite drink and an open, unplanned stretch of time may help you unwind.
restStyle.result.quiet.plan: Put your phone aside, settle into a comfortable spot, and listen to music or simply enjoy a quiet moment.
restStyle.result.movement.name: Movement Reset
restStyle.result.movement.catchphrase: A little movement can clear your head, too.
restStyle.result.movement.description: Your thoughts tend to settle when you move gently and get some fresh air. Easy movement can be a refreshing change of pace.
restStyle.result.movement.good: Take an easy walk or gently stretch. A little movement you can start without pressure may suit you better than a big workout.
restStyle.result.movement.plan: Put on comfortable shoes, play some music, and take a slow walk around your neighborhood.
restStyle.result.connection.name: Connection Recharge
restStyle.result.connection.catchphrase: Time with people you like gives you a lift.
restStyle.result.connection.description: Talking and laughing with someone you feel comfortable with can lift your mood. Time with one or two people you trust may suit you better than a big gathering.
restStyle.result.connection.good: Share an easy meal or conversation with someone close. A relaxed moment with one or two people may feel better than a large group.
restStyle.result.connection.plan: Reach out to someone who comes to mind and have a short chat about something easy.
restStyle.result.immersion.name: Focused Recharge
restStyle.result.immersion.catchphrase: You recharge when you get absorbed in something you love.
restStyle.result.immersion.description: You get more satisfaction from enjoying an interest without interruptions. Even a small hobby can lift your mood when you have time to focus.
restStyle.result.immersion.good: Pick a hobby you enjoy, such as reading, gaming, or drawing. Turning off notifications for a while can help you enjoy it more fully.
restStyle.result.immersion.plan: Choose one hobby you have been putting off and enjoy it for a little while without distractions.
restStyle.result.novelty.name: New Discovery
restStyle.result.novelty.catchphrase: Fresh views and small discoveries give you a boost.
restStyle.result.novelty.description: A new experience can refresh you when everyday life starts to feel familiar. You do not have to travel far; a new route or nearby place may be enough.
restStyle.result.novelty.good: Explore a nearby place or take a route you do not usually use. A small discovery without a big plan may be enough to refresh your mood.
restStyle.result.novelty.plan: Pick a nearby place you have not visited and take your time looking around.

hobbyDiscovery.title: What hobby might suit me?
hobbyDiscovery.intro: If you tried a new hobby, what kind of activity would you enjoy? Pick what draws you in across a few everyday situations.
hobbyDiscovery.aboutHeading: Small clues to the hobbies you enjoy
hobbyDiscovery.aboutCopy: Instead of picking what sounds impressive, notice which parts of an activity draw you in: making something, caring for it, mixing flavors, or looking closely. The result is a starting point for trying a hobby, not a list you have to follow.
hobbyDiscovery.resultGuide: If an idea appeals to you, try a small version with library materials, a trial class, or tools you already have before buying supplies. See whether you enjoy the process, then decide if you want to keep going. The result is an idea based on the choices you made today.

hobbyDiscovery.answer.8.observer: What might stand out if I looked a little closer

hobbyDiscovery.answer.9.grower: Knowing some changes need more time to show

hobbyDiscovery.answer.10.grower: A small change I got to watch unfold

hobbyDiscovery.answer.10.maker: Something I found a way to improve myself

hobbyDiscovery.answer.11.flavor: Opening up the conversation with a new topic or option

hobbyDiscovery.result.maker.name: The hands-on maker
hobbyDiscovery.result.maker.imageAlt: Four cartoon panels of a woman folding a small cardboard desk organizer and putting pens inside
hobbyDiscovery.result.maker.catchphrase: It feels good when an idea becomes something you can hold.
hobbyDiscovery.result.maker.description: You enjoy handling an idea, making it, and adjusting it as you go. A small object or model with a visible result may suit you better than planning a big project from the start.
hobbyDiscovery.result.maker.shareDescrip: Your hobby style leans toward making something by hand and finishing it.
hobbyDiscovery.result.maker.good: Try an activity with a hands-on result, such as paper craft, miniature building, or simple woodworking.
hobbyDiscovery.result.maker.firstStep: Fold a small desk organizer from spare paper or a cardboard box today.
hobbyDiscovery.result.grower.name: The patient grower
hobbyDiscovery.result.grower.imageAlt: Four cartoon panels of a woman planting a seed in a small cup and watching the sprout grow
hobbyDiscovery.result.grower.catchphrase: You enjoy caring for small changes and giving them time.
hobbyDiscovery.result.grower.description: You find satisfaction in caring for something and noticing how it changes. A hobby that combines patience and hands-on care, such as growing herbs or starting seeds, may suit you.
hobbyDiscovery.result.grower.shareDescri: Your hobby style leans toward caring for small changes as they grow.
hobbyDiscovery.result.grower.good: Look into activities with visible growth, such as growing herbs or a few small vegetables.
hobbyDiscovery.result.grower.firstStep: Plant a bean or herb seed in a small cup and set it somewhere sunny.
hobbyDiscovery.result.flavor.name: The flavor experimenter
hobbyDiscovery.result.flavor.imageAlt: Four cartoon panels of a man adding berries to yogurt, tasting the new snack, and smiling
hobbyDiscovery.result.flavor.catchphrase: You enjoy mixing ingredients and finding the difference in taste.
hobbyDiscovery.result.flavor.description: You enjoy tasting, adjusting the proportions, and finding a combination of your own. Small experiments, such as making a snack or mixing a drink, are a good place to begin.
hobbyDiscovery.result.flavor.shareDescri: Your hobby style leans toward experimenting with new flavor combinations.
hobbyDiscovery.result.flavor.good: Try changing ingredient combinations through sauces, simple baking, or tea and drink blends.
hobbyDiscovery.result.flavor.firstStep: Add one topping or spice to a snack today and see how the flavor changes.
hobbyDiscovery.result.observer.name: The careful observer
hobbyDiscovery.result.observer.imageAlt: Four cartoon panels of a man noticing cloud changes and recording them in a sketchbook
hobbyDiscovery.result.observer.catchphra: You enjoy noticing and recording changes others might miss.
hobbyDiscovery.result.observer.descripti: You notice small details when you spend time looking closely at one subject. Try recording something that changes from day to day, such as the night sky, weather, or birds.
hobbyDiscovery.result.observer.shareDesc: Your hobby style leans toward observing one subject closely and keeping a record.
hobbyDiscovery.result.observer.good: Explore a hobby that tracks one subject over time, such as stargazing, cloud watching, or birding.
hobbyDiscovery.result.observer.firstStep: Take one photo or make a short note about tonight's moon or sky color.
hobbyDiscovery.result.puzzler.name: The puzzle designer
hobbyDiscovery.result.puzzler.imageAlt: Four cartoon panels of a woman creating a shape-pattern puzzle that her friend solves
hobbyDiscovery.result.puzzler.catchphras: You like turning clues and rules into a satisfying solution.
hobbyDiscovery.result.puzzler.descriptio: You feel proud when you find a pattern or watch someone enjoy a rule you created. A hobby that gives structure to an idea, such as logic puzzles, board-game design, or escape-room riddles, may suit you.
hobbyDiscovery.result.puzzler.shareDescr: Your hobby style leans toward connecting rules and clues to make puzzles or games.
hobbyDiscovery.result.puzzler.good: Try an activity built around rules and solutions, such as logic puzzles, board-game design, or simple coding.
hobbyDiscovery.result.puzzler.firstStep: Draw three shapes on paper and make a short puzzle where a friend can discover the rule.
